description: This file defines the UpdateFilter class, which is a servlet filter in the OpenMRS web application. It manages the process of checking for required database updates, authenticating super users, and running database migrations and startup procedures related to Liquibase updates during application startup or maintenance. It includes methods for user authentication, update execution, and progress reporting, as well as handling update-related UI interactions.

classes.name: UpdateFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that manages OpenMRS database updates, user authentication for updates, and triggers Liquibase migrations during startup or maintenance. It handles user interactions for update approval, progress monitor, and error management, ensuring database schema is current before allowing user access.

classes.name: UpdateFilter.UpdateFilterCompletion
classes.description: An inner class responsible for executing the database update process, including applying changelogs, starting the application, reporting errors, warnings, and progress state.

methods.name: checkLocaleAttributesForFirstTime
methods.description: Sets user locale attribute based on request or system default during first access.

methods.name: authenticateAsSuperUser
methods.description: Authenticates a user as Super User based on username and password by querying the database.

methods.name: isSuperUser
methods.description: Checks whether a given user ID has the superuser role.

methods.name: startOpenmrs
methods.description: Initializes and starts the OpenMRS server components during update completion.
